text:
Predicates:
Season(x) ::: x is a season in a year.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Love(x, y) ::: x loves y the most.
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
WantsLongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WantsLongVacation(x) → Love(x, summer)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
FavoriteSeason(emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
FavoriteSeason(mia, y) ∧ ¬(y = summer) ∧ FavoriteSeason(emma, y) ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
WantsLongVacation(james) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.
Conclusion:
FavoriteSeason(mia, spring) ::: Mia's favorite season is spring.
